images.prompt: A recently vacated office chair lit from one side, a red notebook left on the seat; the desk behind it dark and unlit.
images.usage: Facebook + X (16:9). LinkedIn and Instagram take the full 10-slide carousel.
images.qa: Approved first roll. The empty chair plus a notebook left behind carries 'the reason lives in one person' without a figure in frame. Every device on the desk is dark, which is what keeps the single-red rule intact.
